Container.Name: AzuriteAzureStorage
Container.Overview: Local Azure Storage emulator powered by Azurite with a built-in web UI for browsing blobs, queues, tables, and file shares. Drop-in replacement for Azure Storage in development.
Container.Description: Runs Microsoft Azurite (Azure Storage emulator) with a bundled web-based Storage Explorer UI. Provides Blob (port 10000), Queue (10001), and Table (10002) services with full API compatibility. Includes a web dashboard (port 8080) for browsing and managing storage contents — blobs, queues, tables, and file shares — similar to Azure Storage Explorer desktop. Data persists across restarts. Connect from other containers using the standard Azure Storage connection string with Azurite's well-known development credentials.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for Azurite data (blobs, queues, tables)
